papers.headline: Improving cosmological distance measurements at high redshift using Lyman-Alpha forest BAO reconstruction
papers.summary: The Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) measures baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO) in the Lyman-α (Lyman-alpha) forest and provides a robust probe of the expansion history in the matter-dominated era.
papers.title: Improving cosmological distance measurements at high redshift using Lyman-Alpha forest BAO reconstruction

papers.headline: The Spatially-Resolved Recent Star Formation History of the M81 Disk
papers.summary: The nearby M81 galaxy–-a tidally interacting L^* spiral disk–-offers a unique perspective on the interplay of secular and external processes in shaping galaxy properties.
papers.title: The Spatially-Resolved Recent Star Formation History of the M81 Disk

papers.headline: A Quiet Night in the Millihertz Sky? LISA Forecasts from LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA Populations
papers.summary: The high-mass black hole population inferred from ground-based observations can substantially affect the number of binaries detectable by the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA).
papers.title: A Quiet Night in the Millihertz Sky? LISA Forecasts from LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA Populations
